The complaints panel shall render its decision without an oral hearing. The complaint is not required to be made before the end of the case. The complainants are entitled to a hearing at the Federal Constitutional Court before the matter is heard again by the panel. The panel will then decide whether or not to award compensation to the complainants. The compensation is to be calculated in the light of the circumstances of the particular case.
